description: A record collector with a duplicate box set must decide whether to trade it for a neighbor's custom record cabinet, then finalize the cabinet specifications and handoff after checking the practical terms with the people involved.

agents.name: Caleb
agents.role: Cabinet Maker and Prospective Trading Partner

shared_context.S1: Iris has a complete duplicate 1960s jazz box set that she is considering trading informally.
shared_context.S2: Caleb has offered to discuss a custom record cabinet in exchange for the box set.
shared_context.S3: The cabinet would be placed in the living room of Iris and June's shared home.
shared_context.S4: At their record-club meetups, Iris routinely asks the trading partner and the affected housemate to formally disclose and confirm their exact terms or measurements, records each confirmation, and does not agree until both confirmations have been made.

PF1.text: Caleb's actual proposal is a hand-built oak cabinet measuring exactly 80 centimeters wide and 35 centimeters deep, exchanged for Iris's complete box set with no cash added, with delivery on Saturday at 11:00.

PF2.text: June measured the only usable living-room alcove and it is exactly 82 centimeters wide and 40 centimeters deep; a cabinet exceeding either measurement would block the nearby door.

acceptance_conditions: The trading partner must be Caleb.
The exchanged item must be Iris's complete 1960s jazz box set.
The cabinet must be exactly 80 centimeters wide and 35 centimeters deep.
The settlement must include a commitment of type delivery whose detail specifies Saturday at 11:00.
June's measured alcove dimensions must be cited as justification for the cabinet size.
Caleb's exact proposal must be cited as justification for the agreed trade terms.

content_checks.C2: (decisions['item_exchanged'] == 'complete 1960s jazz box set' or decisions['item_exchanged'] == 'Complete duplicate 1960s jazz box set') and decisions['cash_added'] == 0
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'delivery' and 'Saturday' in c['detail'] and '11:00' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Caleb's exact proposal changes the settlement to Caleb as partner, the complete box set with zero cash, an 80-by-35-centimeter cabinet, Saturday delivery at 11:00, a delivery commitment, and the required citation of his terms.

June's exact 82-by-40-centimeter alcove measurements establish that Caleb's cabinet must remain exactly within those dimensions and provide the required cited justification for accepting the 80-by-35-centimeter size.
